files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready transparent sprite atlas for a side-view hand-painted dark fantasy 2D platform action game.
Primary request: Generate one 1536×1024 landscape RGBA PNG with exactly SIX separate elegant, long, shallow walkable platform sprites. Real alpha transparency everywhere outside the six sprites. Logical layout is TWO columns by FOUR rows; ONLY the first three rows contain sprites, two per row. The entire fourth row (y=768 through 1023) is COMPLETELY EMPTY AND TRANSPARENT. Do not draw a grid, panels, labels, text, numerals, border, checkerboard or background.
Composition/framing: Invisible cells are 768×256 pixels. Each platform is horizontally centered within its cell, approximately 650px wide and 110–140px total height, aspect ratio approximately 5:1. For row one use a flat walkable top line near y=85, row two near y=341, row three near y=597. Leave broad transparent margins above, below, and on both sides. Keep sprites fully isolated with no stray particles crossing cells. Platforms must be true side-on game platforms with only a very slight view of the flat top. Long horizontal clear flat standing surfaces with subtle chips at the outermost ends; no big rocks or bones sticking up above the walk line. Main body is thin and shallow with only SHORT attached underside details. Aim for low horizontal shelf silhouettes, not tall floating islands.
Style/medium: Fine detailed hand-painted original 2D dark fantasy game art, refined sculptural stone and bone texture, painterly edge highlights, material detail readable at small size. Cohesive restrained low-saturation palette; moderate value contrast and soft directional top light. High craft, no cartoon, no photoreal 3D rendering, no vector look.
Six exact designs in reading order:
TOP LEFT, stage 9 White-Bone Royal City variant A: an ancient grey carved masonry castle cornice with pale aged bone inlays, a clearly level grey flagstone cap, compact short carved supports and occasional tiny embedded skull relief on the front face. Bone is integrated into shallow masonry, not dangling.
TOP RIGHT, stage 9 variant B: a long pale tombstone limestone shelf made of broad interlocking grave-slab blocks and a small number of short rib-bone segments embedded across the shallow front. Distinct segmented pale limestone silhouette and material, clearly different from the grey castle cornice. All bones stay under the level top; non-gory, no gore.
MIDDLE LEFT, stage 10 Thunderbone Sky Ridge variant A: a cold grey cracked storm basalt slab with horizontally layered rock faces, a slightly chipped level walking cap and just a few dim muted antique-gold electrical vein engravings. Shallow compact rock body, no bright lightning effects.
MIDDLE RIGHT, stage 10 variant B: a black stone architectural eave with pale dragon-bone edging and a very shallow arched motif across its front. Broad dark level walking top, short attached bone trim, not long ribs or tusks. Different constructed silhouette and bone-versus-basalt material balance from the basalt platform.
LOWER LEFT, stage 11 Faceless Star Abyss variant A: a long shallow violet-black stone tablet ledge incised with restrained tiny antique-gold star-map lines and geometric seals; worn flat top, elegant engraved thin front face, a few small short bracket details. No large bright galaxy or glow.
LOWER RIGHT, stage 11 variant B: a shallow broken black obsidian geometric shelf, angular interlocked planar slabs with a continuous clear level top, subtle purple star dust only within the object silhouette, minimal muted glints. Distinct fractured geometric silhouette, no gold ornamental frame, clearly different from the engraved tablet.
Constraints: Six sprites exactly, two per row across first three rows; last row entirely transparent. Every pair must differ in actual material and silhouette, not mirrored or recolored duplicates. Thin shallow platform bodies, approximate width-to-height ratio 5:1. No long downwards spikes, cones, pillars, stalactites, roots, drapes, hanging strings or long bone ribs. No huge hanging chunks. No tall floating islands. No feet, characters, weapons, architecture in background, scene, floor plane, cast background shadow, text, labels, watermark, border, fake transparency checkerboard. No high-intensity lightning or particle VFX. Preserve plentiful real transparent negative space.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: one transparent PNG game platform sprite atlas, exact canvas size 1536×1024.
Edit the reference atlas with one precise correction: increase each platform's SHALLOW FRONT BODY depth to 120 pixels total height while keeping its width near 650 pixels. Current sprites are too thin. Move the walking top to y=85 for first row, y=341 for second row, y=597 for third row. Lowest short attached detail must end before y=215 / 471 / 727 respectively. Do not make any spike, cone, island, or hanging long decoration. The shape should be a thin shelf with approximately 5.4:1 width-to-total-height ratio, not a superthin strip or tall island.
Keep the six polished hand-painted dark fantasy designs, their two-column three-populated-row reading order, restrained colors, and flat continuous walkable tops. First row: grey bone-inlaid castle cornice on left, pale segmented tombstone limestone and short embedded ribs on right. Second row: cracked cold grey storm basalt with dim gold veins on left, dragon-bone edged black stone shallow architectural arch eave on right. Third row: purple-black gold-engraved star tablet on left, fractured geometric black obsidian slab on right. Every pair stays materially and structurally distinct, not mirrored or recolored. Main body shallow and horizontally stretched; no tall floating islands.
Invisible cell layout is TWO columns by FOUR rows, each cell 768×256. Sprites centered at x=384 and x=1152. First three rows contain exactly six sprites. Final fourth row y=768–1023 must be totally EMPTY with alpha=0. All areas outside the six precise sprite cutout silhouettes must have alpha=0, including the large margins and between rows. Remove every background haze, gradient, light cloud, shadow, vignette, tiny speck, semi-transparent noise and detached particle outside the sprites. Never paint a background. The outside is actual clean transparency, not black, not gray, not white, not a checkerboard. Pixels strictly within the platforms should be opaque except antialiased silhouette edges.
No text, numbers, labels, frames, panel separators, characters, scenery, background floor or watermark. Keep fine hand-painted bone and stone material detail and original consistent visual quality.
